effects.printed_clause: If you control another Scarstech monster (Quick Effect): You can send this face-up card to the GY; destroy a number of cards your opponent controls equal to the Chain Link number of this effect.
effects.lua_implementation: A free-chain Monster Zone Quick Effect requires another face-up Scarstech, sends the handler to GY as cost, calculates current chain+1 for legality/current chain once registered, requires exactly that many destructible opponent cards, then selects and destroys exactly the stored count.

official_references.matched_structure: Scales an operation by this effect's Chain Link number using Duel.GetCurrentChain.
Correct current-link capture during target registration.

effects.printed_clause: When a card or effect is activated as Chain Link 3 or higher while this card is in your GY (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card.
effects.lua_implementation: An EVENT_CHAINING Quick Effect in GY checks ev>=3, a free zone and Necrovalley-aware self-summon legality, then revives the handler.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each effect of Scarstech Principality once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The destroy and self-revival effects use id and id+100 hard once-per-turn keys.

coverage_override.reason: The three records separately cover the send-to-GY-cost destruction effect, the Chain-Link-3-or-higher self-revival effect, and both distinct once-per-turn limits. The heuristic double-counts the Special Summon performed by self-revival.
